articles.title: She Builds Circuits That Talk to Satellites—and She Started by Fixing Toasters!
articles.summary: Ana Inês Inácio designs tiny radio chips for satellites and radar. She won a big award for her work and for helping young engineers around the world. Her first teacher was her grandpa, who fixed machines in their village.

articles.title: Scientists Borrow a Superpower from Wrinkly, Cancer-Proof Mole Rats—and Give It to Mice!
articles.summary: Naked mole rats can live 41 years and almost never get cancer. Scientists took one of their special genes and put it into mice. The mice lived longer and stayed healthier, with less inflammation and fewer tumors.

articles.title: A NASA Spacecraft Is About to Slingshot Past Mars at 12,000 MPH—and It's Taking Pictures!
articles.summary: NASA's Psyche probe will zoom just 2,800 miles above Mars on May 15, using the planet's gravity to speed up on its way to a metal asteroid. It will snap thousands of photos and test its instruments.
